newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to sell 26 pct of oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to sell 26 pct of oil refinery.

text.p: Ukraine's State Property Fund plans to sell a 26 percent stake in the Nadvirnyansky oil refinery to local and foreign strategic investors, a refinery spokesman said on Friday.

"The main condition for us is that the investor be involved in modernisation, which would cost about $150 million," said Vasyl Dudchak, deputy director of AO Naftokhimik Prykarpatya, located in western Ukraine.
Dudchak said a date for the tender had not been set.
The fund, the state privatisation agency, has said 32.95 percent of the refinery would remain in government hands.
Ukrainians have already purchased a 30 percent stake with privatisation certificates, workers own 6.05 percent and managers five percent.
Last year the plant, built in 1955, refined 889,000 tonnes of oil compared to 1.05 million tonnes in 1995.
Ukraine's six refineries' total refining capacity is up to 60 million tonnes and privatisation has started on all of them.
